dedupe_keys.name: dynamic testing of a four storey building with reinforced concrete and unreinforced masonry walls shake table data set

description: This dataset was recorded during the shake-table test of a half-scale four-storey building with mixed reinforced concrete and unreinforced masonry walls, a structural system common in older European buildings. The test was performed at the TREES laboratory of EUCENTRE in Pavia, Italy, within research at EPFL in Lausanne on the seismic behaviour of mixed structures, and the data were published on Zenodo on 3 September 2014 by Marco Tondelli, Sarah Petry, Simone Peloso and Katrin Beyer. The test unit was subjected to several shakings of increasing intensity; the release documents geometry, material properties and instrumentation, and gives unprocessed data and a processed set with conversions and corrections. Coverage: one test building. Access: ten RAR archives, about 3.4 GB in all, with a description of the data organisation. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0; free. Caveats: a half-scale laboratory specimen, so scaling effects apply. Simulation uses are calibration of numerical models and fragility functions for mixed RC and masonry buildings. Related records: the NEES BNCS full-scale building test and the Irpinia empirical fragility data.
